newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO says may buy stainless steel plants.
newsitem.headline: POSCO says may buy stainless steel plants.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd confirmed it was in talks to take over parts of Sammi Steel Co Ltd's stainless steel business, including those overseas, POSCO officials said on Tuesday.

"We are positively considering taking Sammi's offer," said a POSCO official who asked not to be named. "Our basic stance is that we would like to take over Sammi's plants not only in Changwon but in Canada and the United States as well."
Earlier, Sammi said it was negotiating with POSCO to sell 50 percent of its stainless steel business due to recent financial difficulties.
A Sammi official earlier said it planned to sell its stainless steel round bar and thinless extruded pipe and tube businesses.
According to the official, the stainless steel maker invested a total of C$250 million in 1989 to take over plants in Canada and in the United States.
